snippet.title: C64 Longplay: Zoids (NTSC) (sound effects mode)
snippet.description:
This is the quickest way I know of beating the game. See onscreen notes and/or the following links to remove any confusion. It sure was confusing for me back in the day, but recently I put a lot more effort into figuring it out.
